title: PR #95: governance: add trust and evidence status framework
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: False

## Scope
Implements the canonical project trust/transparency framework without asserting readiness.

### Added
- `schemas/governance/project-status.schema.json`
- `governance/status.json`
- `governance/CLAIM_TO_EVIDENCE.md`
- `governance/RESIDUALS.md`
- `governance/ATTRIBUTION.md`
- `governance/SECURITY.md`
- `governance/validate.py`
- `PROJECT_STATUS.md`

### CI
Extends the existing Repository Governance workflow with an evidence-framework validation job.

### Evidence policy
- Exact 40-character source SHA required.
- `VERIFIED` requires independent audit/reproduction evidence and no residuals.
- Failed gates remain failed evidence; no automatic PASS/VERIFIED generation.
- ShivaCore baseline remains BLOCKED.
- Dependency Review remains a documented non-blocking residual because Dependency Graph support is unavailable.

### Deliberate omission
No third-party attribution entry was invented. The previously proposed `poke-env` row is not present in this repository and therefore is not registered as used.

Next lifecycle step after merge: repair ShivaCore baseline, then rebase/reverify globus-os PR #37 and only then advance statuses.
